title: slot_coord: register_gateway failure ignored on accept path grants invisible gateway
description: Codereview finding (P3, pre-existing, adjacent to persist-first wiring): coap_slot_coord.c:513 ignores lichen_slot_coord_register_gateway's return. When the coord table is full, a claim is committed (seq burned), ACCEPTED returned, grant handed out — but no table entry exists, so the gateway is invisible to conflict resolution and overlapping slot grants become possible. Decide: reject the claim when registration fails (return an error result) or document the accepted loss. Discovered from project-LICHEN-worker6-uiun 3x codereview.
